visualCharacteristics: Slider of tall 9:16 video poster cards (about 3.5 visible) with play icon and white title overlay at the bottom; click opens a fullscreen video modal; prev/next arrows and progress bar; swipe/drag.
contentPattern: Carousel of 5 portrait video slides (Will not burn**, Engineered for Climate, Creating possibilities, Leading transformation, Holds little appeal for pests); each shows a poster, play icon and title; click opens the video in a fullscreen player
usage: Slider of portrait (9:16) video poster cards; clicking a card plays the video in a fullscreen overlay.
reuseGuidance: One row per slide: poster image | title plus a link to the video (mp4, YouTube or Vimeo). A slide without a video link renders as a plain image card.
structure: One row per slide: poster image | title, video link
